meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 装上后,它会把你本地的 Flask、Django、FastAPI 等 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux;缺资源时自动新建资源组、计划和应用,部署完打印提示并结束。
howto.when: 当你说「Flask App Service」等词,或要把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发;Container Apps、Functions 及非 Python/IaC 场景不适用。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 缺资源时会自动新建资源组、计划和应用

say.text: 帮我把 FastAPI 项目部署到 App Service Linux
say.note: 会为 FastAPI 设置 uvicorn 启动命令

say.text: 用 azd 部署这个 Django 项目到 App Service
say.note: 有 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径

howto.what_en: Once installed, it deploys your Flask, Django or FastAPI Python code to Azure App Service Linux, creating the resource group, plan and web app if missing, then prints a post-deploy message and ends the turn.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "Flask App Service" or ask to deploy Python to App Service; not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python or IaC work.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Creates the resource group, plan and web app if missing

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI project to App Service Linux
Use azd to deploy this Django project to App Service
